matching.location: 2024 PDG inputs in Eq.(2), SM MSbar estimates at MZ in Eq.(4); M_H fitted as input 125.20+/-0.11 GeV. Use dimensionless parameters and v only, exclude their lambda.

neutrino.spectrum: NO, solar and atmospheric central; masses in eV converted to GeV; m1=0.

atlas.meaning: Observed mass from diphoton and four-lepton channels at 7, 8, 13 TeV; 0.09 statistical, 0.06 systematic, total 0.11 GeV.

historical_check.interpretation: Chosen broad on-shell proxy bounds for sign check; not confidence limits or exact conversion between mass schemes.
